subject: Acadia Health: prompt artifact retirement & log sanitization confirmation
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha@acadiahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acadia Health Security Team <security@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request to retire prompts/outputs and sanitize inference logs (Acadia)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Acadia has a formal retention update and we need to retire a set of prompt artifacts + associated inference output and transient logs tied to a pilot dataset (Pilot-ACD-2025). The security team asked for a clearly auditable run, SHA proofs for any archived manifests, and confirmation that KV cache slices and per-request logs are wiped.

Can Redwood run the retirement workflow for the following scope?
- Model: redwood-gpt-large-v1 (hosted endpoint: rw-prod-us-east-3)
- Time window: 2025-07-01 -> 2026-02-28
- Objects: prompt artifacts, model outputs (generated text), request metadata and transient logs, KV-cache snapshots created by the session cache service

We'd like a timeline (ETA), a simple checklist we can attach to our SOC evidence folder, and the final confirmation email to include hash values for any proof bundles. Is this something you can schedule this week?

Appreciate it — Samantha
Security & Privacy Program Manager
Acadia Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Acadia Health Security Team <security@acadiahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to retire prompts/outputs and sanitize inference logs (Acadia)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear scope. We can run a controlled retirement for Pilot-ACD-2025 and provide audit artifacts. High-level plan:

1) Ticket & runbook kickoff (today) — create secure job in private ops queue.
2) Snapshot & snapshot-hash generation — we take short-lived snapshots for internal verification, compute SHA256 for the bundle, and then delete snapshots after proof generation.
3) KV-cache sweep — targeted sweep of KV partitions for the session IDs in scope.
4) Output + request-log purge — remove generated output blobs and per-request logs; retain an audit record (timestamp, job id, hashed manifest).
5) Proof bundle delivery — deliver signed ZIP with manifest.csv, SHA256 checksums, and a short runbook PDF.

ETA: We can start tomorrow (2026-11-05) and aim to complete by EOD 2026-11-07 if nothing unexpected appears. We'll include a friendly acceptance checkbox for you to sign off before final removal.

I'll loop in Marissa and Neha to schedule the ops window and produce the evidence.

— Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acadia Health Security Team <security@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request to retire prompts/outputs and sanitize inference logs (Acadia) — ops plan

Team — quick ops plan / checklist before we run:

- Confirm ticket: OPS-ERASE-4521 (locked to Acadia account and marked high-audit).
- Pre-run data export: small manifest of object IDs for cross-checking (attached: kv_sample_index_20261107.csv).
- Run window: 2026-11-06 02:00–04:30 UTC (low traffic).
- Steps during run (automated + manual):
  * Lock routes to prevent new writes to affected partitions.
  * Export minimal manifest, compute SHA256 of manifest -> record.
  * Execute KV-cache targeted sweep (per-partition) and validate zero-count.
  * Delete output blobs and request logs flagged in manifest.
  * Run verification tool (logchain verifier) to ensure no dangling references.
- Post-run: generate redwood_erase_proof_20261107.zip with:
  * manifest.csv (object ids + timestamps)
  * proof.log (run output with checksums)
  * runbook pdf (redwood_retirement_runbook_20261107.pdf)

Neha — you will be the sign-off for verification. Jordan — once we have verification, I'll prepare the final confirmation email to Acadia with SHA256s and the DocuSign link for acceptance.

Marissa
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acadia Health Security Team <security@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T12:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: OPS-ERASE-4521 — verification & evidence bundle ready

On Sat, Nov 7, 2026 at 04:30 AM UTC, ops-runner@redwood.ai wrote:
> Run complete: OPS-ERASE-4521
> Deleted: 2,374 prompt artifacts, 12,081 output blobs, 14 request-log files, 18 KV-cache partitions (IDs listed in manifest).
> Verification: logchain verifier v2.3 reports: zero dangling refs; KV-sweep success confirmed.

Marissa / Jordan — I've completed the verification steps and signed the internal acceptance. Attached is the proof bundle and runbook we will send to Acadia. Key artifacts in bundle:
- manifest.csv (object id, original timestamp, deletion timestamp)
- proof.log (run output + verification hashes)
- redwood_retirement_runbook_20261107.pdf (steps we executed)
- kv_sample_index_20261107.csv (sample ids for your review)

SHA256 of redwood_erase_proof_20261107.zip: f2b9d6f6c4d21a3c957fe8a07f3e6b5c2d4a1b8e1d9c6f7a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c

Marissa — ready for you to send final confirmation to the customer.

— Neha
Director, Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
